Manufacturing Engineer

About the role
We are seeking a Manufacturing Engineer to join our production engineering
team. Reporting to the Head of Operations, you will own process design and
continuous improvement across two assembly lines.

Responsibilities
- Lead root cause analysis on production defects and drive corrective actions
  through to closure.
- Develop and maintain process flow documentation, work instructions and
  technical reports for the manufacturing floor.
- Carry out time studies to establish standard work and identify waste.
- Support quality control activities and ensure adherence to quality standards
  across all production cells.
- Produce and revise part drawings using CAD/CAM software.
- Drive lean manufacturing initiatives, including 5S, kaizen events and value
  stream mapping.
- Own process changes from proposal through validation and release.
- Contribute to quality assurance audits and maintain ISO 9001 documentation.

Requirements
- Degree in mechanical engineering, industrial engineering or a related
  discipline.
- 3+ years of experience in manufacturing engineering or a comparable
  production environment.
- Proficiency in SolidWorks and AutoCAD is essential.
- Demonstrated experience with root cause analysis methodologies such as 8D,
  5 Whys and fishbone diagrams.
- Working knowledge of ISO 9001 and quality standards in a regulated setting.
- Familiarity with lean manufacturing and Six Sigma principles.
- Strong communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to
  present technical reports to non-technical stakeholders.
- Highly detail-oriented and analytical, with a consistent approach to
  documentation.
- Able to follow instructions precisely and work to defined quality standards.

What we offer
Competitive salary, pension, and a genuine say in how the plant runs.
